d:
Somvar ke din ka praranbh karen Monday Morning Best shivji ke bhajnon se Anuradha Paudwal ke svaron men: man mera mandir shiv meri puja, he shambhu baba mere bholenath, chalo shiv shankar ke mandir men , shiv shankar ko jisne puja, shiv amritvani
Aisi subah na aaye, Om nam shivay (dhun), subah subah tu nis din, mahamrityunjay mantr 11 bar, subah-subah le shiv ka nam, Om jay shiv omkara
Man Mera Mandir Shiv Meri Puja 00:00:06
Hey Shambhu Baba Mere Bholenath 06:17
Chalo Shiv Shankar Ke Mandir Mein 10:37
Shiv Shankar Ko Jisne Pooja 16:42
Shiv Amritwani 22:18
Aisi Subah Na Aaye 27:12
